name: list_channels
title: Numbers and mailboxes
description:
Lists the workspace's sending numbers, mailboxes and web chat widgets: id, type, the number or address,
whether it is active, and whether a campaign may send from it (`campaign_sender`), and why not. A
connected mailbox also has `connection`: whether it works, and what is wrong if not. `get_mailbox_setup`
says how to add a mailbox.

include_inactive.description: Include switched-off numbers. Defaults to false.
